name: Customer Service & Communication
summary: Proactive status updates, faster support routing, and far fewer "just checking in" calls.
description: Customers rarely complain about waiting. They complain about not knowing. Most inbound "where are we on this?" calls are a symptom of updates that never went out. These automations send the update before the customer has to ask: job and order status, delays, results, care instructions, outage notices, and check-ins. They also route support requests to the right person with context attached, so nothing sits unanswered in a shared inbox.
